Committee: Health
Sponsor: Sells
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 141 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Public Health by an undetermined amount to establish and administer a community paramedicine program; however, this increase may be offset, in whole or in part, by license fees collected by the Department for community paramedic licensees.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 141 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Department of Public Health by an undetermined amount to establish and administer a community paramedicine program; however, this increase may be offset, in whole or in part, by license fees collected by the Department for community paramedic licensees.
Jim McClendon, Chairperson
